nec51c02344.headline: Cyprus businesses face stricter lending criteria — no change for households
nec51c02344.summary: Lending criteria for Cypriot businesses became stricter in the second quarter of 2024, according to the Central Bank of Cyprus. The tightening was driven mainly by reduced risk tolerance among banks, while households saw no change.
nec51c02344.why: Bank lending standards shape credit availability for businesses and influence economic growth and bank loan portfolio quality.

n799f1f2079.headline: Kazakhstan expects arbitration progress against oil majors next few months

n29755cb982.headline: Azerbaijan studies int'l experience on green taxes

n8e313f0df9.headline: TSX futures fall as China stimulus-led optimism fades

n8e313f0df9.why: The S&P/TSX Composite is Canada's main benchmark and is heavily weighted toward energy and materials, so it is sensitive to oil prices and Chinese demand.

nabc0453bc3.why: The Bank of France is the French central bank, and France's deficit path affects its sovereign borrowing costs and its standing under EU fiscal rules.

n1be43ef95d.why: Nebius is a listed technology company focused on AI cloud infrastructure, and its European build-out ties into demand for data centre capacity.
